Installation

Requirements

  • Python >= 3.9

  • numpy

  • scipy

  • matplotlib

  • ase

  • networkx

  • pandas

  • PlottingTool

Install

Clone the repository and install in editable mode:

cd /path/to/EPRoducer
pip install -e .

This also installs the eproducer command-line tool. To verify:

eproducer -h

ORCA and MATLAB set up

The shell scripts of EPRoducer that run calculations (e.g. gval_workflow, extract_EPRspec and spectrum_from_gval) call load_modules, which sources $HOME/sw/load_modules.sh. Create that file so that it makes the next programs available:

  • ORCA, used by gval_workflow. The variable orca must point to the ORCA binary, e.g.

    orca_path="<absolute path to the Orca directory>"
export PATH=${orca_path}:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:$orca_path"

orca="$orca_path/orca"

  • MATLAB with EasySpin in its path, used by extract_EPRspec and spectrum_from_gval (e.g. module load matlab in a cluster).

gval_postpro and extract_bonds_vmd also need vmd in your PATH.

Build the documentation

This documentation is built with Sphinx and the Read the Docs theme:

pip install sphinx sphinx_rtd_theme
cd doc
make html

The HTML pages are written in doc/_build/html. eproducer doc does this automatically when needed and opens the documentation in your web browser. The pages of the shell scripts (doc/modules/bash_rsts_doc and doc/modules/bash_rsts_scripts) are generated from the scripts on every build by doc/generate_script_docs.py, so they are always up to date. A new script only has to be included in doc/modules/eproducer.rst; the build prints a warning for the scripts that are not.
